name: Chuyu Shi
source: The innocent, tentative stirrings of first love often blossom unexpectedly during our middle school years. In the vast sea of humanity, the chance of two people meeting is less than one in ten thousand. If you could return to that first encounter with her, would you choose her again—through all hardships and obstacles—with unwavering certainty?
